description: Split PDF. Pull pages out of a PDF — a range, a few ranges, or every page as its own file. Accepts application/pdf, .pdf; up to 100 MB per file.

mode.description: What to do: keep the chosen pages, or save every page separately

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

pages.description: Pages, as you would say them: 1-3, 7, 10-12

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

name: pdf_split
